description:
At Woolpert, you’ll do work that matters. 

 As a leading global architecture, engineering, and geospatial firm, we help clients solve complex challenges that shape communities, strengthen critical infrastructure, advance technology, and improve the world around us. Here, you’ll collaborate across disciplines, tackle meaningful projects, and build a career defined by growth, opportunity, and impact. 

 Position Overview 

 Woolpert is seeking a Data Engineer to join our growing Business Intelligence and Data Engineering team. As a Data Engineer, you will be involved in designing, building, and maintaining enterprise data pipelines, data models, and ETL/ELT processes that support Woolpert’s analytics and reporting environment. Working under moderate supervision, this role completes assignments of increasing complexity across the Snowflake and Microsoft Fabric platforms, contributing to the enterprise migration to Snowflake and the modernization of the analytics ecosystem. Collaborates with Finance, Business Intelligence, IT, and business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into technical specifications and relies on more senior data engineers for guidance on complex architecture, performance, and governance decisions.

 We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.  Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

 What You Will Do: 

 Data Pipeline Development & Integration 

 
 Build, test, and maintain data pipelines, data models, and ETL/ELT processes across Snowflake and Microsoft Fabric following established standards and architectural guidance.

 Develop and maintain dimensional models using star and snowflake schemas and fact/dimension structures under the direction of senior team members.

 Assist with the ingestion, mapping, cleansing, and transformation of data from Dynamics 365, Dayforce, Salesforce, and other ERP, CRM, and enterprise systems.

 Write and tune SQL queries, views, and stored procedures to support analytics and reporting needs.

 Support the configuration and optimization of Snowflake environments, including warehouse sizing, performance tuning, and role-based access, escalating complex issues to senior engineers.

 
   Analytics, Quality & Governance Support 

 
 Contribute to the development of semantic models and datasets that support Power BI reporting and self-service analytics.

 Build data structures that support Finance reporting needs such as general ledger reporting, forecasting, budgeting, revenue, and profitability analysis, with guidance from senior team members.

 Collaborate with Business Intelligence developers to ensure data models are optimized for Power BI performance, accuracy, and usability.

 Apply established data quality, governance, lineage, and documentation standards to assigned work.

 Validate data and research discrepancies, refresh failures, and pipeline issues, escalating unresolved or high-impact problems as appropriate.

 
   Operational Support & Development 

 
 Follow established practices for CI/CD, version control, code review, testing, and deployment of data pipelines and models.

 Monitor assigned pipelines and platform jobs for performance and operational health, and complete timely issue resolution within defined guidelines.

 Identify and recommend opportunities to improve automation, reliability, and efficiency within assigned work.

 Document data definitions, pipeline logic, and technical procedures for assigned solutions.

 Participate in knowledge sharing and continue to develop proficiency in modern data engineering and business intelligence practices.

 
   

 What You Will Bring: 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering, Finance, or a related quantitative field required.

 Master's degree preferred, particularly in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Finance, or a related discipline.

 
 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:   

 
 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or related disciplines. Advanced education may be considered in lieu of a portion of the required experience (e.g., a Master's degree may substitute for up to 2 years of relevant experience).

 Experience designing and managing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms.

 Experience partnering with Finance, Accounting, Sales and business leadership teams to deliver analytics solutions.

 
 REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES: 

 
 Proficiency in SQL, including query writing and basic performance tuning.

 Advanced experience with Snowflake data warehousing, data modeling, and performance optimization.

 Deep experience designing and delivering analytics solutions using Microsoft's data and analytics platform, including Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI, with expertise in data integration, semantic modeling, dashboard development, and enterprise reporting.

 Understanding of relational databases, ETL/ELT concepts, dimensional modeling, data quality, and data governance.

 Proficiency with Azure DevOps and Git-based source control for CI/CD and collaborative development.

 Strong understanding of financial reporting, KPI development, budgeting, forecasting, and business performance analytics.

 Strong problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and attention-to-detail skills.

 
 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: 

 
 Experience with dbt, Azure Data Factory, or similar data orchestration tools.

 Experience integrating data from ERP, CRM, human capital management, or related enterprise platforms, including Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, Dayforce, or Salesforce.

 Experience developing and supporting API integrations and data ingestion frameworks.

 Experience supporting financial analytics or enterprise reporting environments.

 Experience working within AEG/AEC industry

 
   PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, OR TRAINING: 

 
 Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate

 Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate

 Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate

 Snowflake SnowPro Core Certification

 
 PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES: 

 
 Working knowledge of DAX.

 Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data lineage, and role-based access control.

 Familiarity with cloud data platform architecture, DevOps practices, and modern analytics ecosystems.

 Familiarity with financial data structures, including general ledger, forecasting, budgeting, revenue, and profitability data.

 
 #LI-Remote

 Benefits You Will Love 

 Certified as a Great Place to Work, Woolpert is one of the fastest-growing architecture, engineering, and geospatial companies in the world. With over 75 offices and countless projects around the globe, you’ll work on meaningful assignments that improve quality of life around the world. In addition to offering competitive pay, we provide employees with a robust set of unique benefits, including:

 
 Freedom to Work program: Set your own schedule and location (as appropriate).

 Principal program: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.

 Flexible paid time off/vacation: Take time off when it makes sense for you and your team.

 Career development: Explore a wide range of learning and growth opportunities within and across industries.

 Health, life, vision, and dental insurance: Cover all your medical bases.

 Paid sick time, retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, pet insurance, identity protection, technology stipend, employee assistance program, and more!

 
  

  

  

  
 Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

 Pay Range
 $87,100 — $108,900 USD 


 Find out more about what Woolpert has to offer here:  http://woolpert.com/about-us/ 

 Woolpert is an equal-opportunity employer. Woolpert is committed to the full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, compensate, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.  You may view more about EEO on our website: Equal-Employment-Opportunity-The-Law.pdf and EEO is the Law Poster Supplement . 

 Applicants who require an accommodation throughout the application and interview process should request this in advance by contacting your Recruiter 

 To all agencies: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of Woolpert or any of our subsidiaries about this requisition. All resumes submitted by search firms/employment agencies to any employee at Woolpert via email, the internet, or in any form and/or method will be deemed the sole property of Woolpert, unless such search firms/employment agencies were engaged by Woolpert's Talent Acquisition Team for this requisition and a valid agreement is in place. In the event a candidate who was submitted outside of Woolpert's applicant process is hired, no fee or payment of any kind will be paid.
